conclusions: The in-box restoration arc is feasible on the measured substrate. None of the three STOP criteria fired.
Supervision story shrinks to a systemd unit (Restart= policy) — no bespoke supervisor needed.

#180's clean fix is declarative: /etc/tmpfiles.d/qds-steering.conf 'd /run/steering 0700 exedev exedev' (or move channel to persistent disk) — systemd recreates at every boot; no re-provision code path required.

Runtime route options both open: custom OCI image (preferred — also pins pi, retires 0.55.0/0.84.x drift) or setup-script bun install; compiled-engine route additionally proven viable by pi itself being a compiled ELF.
